game.title: TestRoom001: the lab
game.note: A test game, not a story (DECISIONS 2026-10-28, back): a lab whose rooms each test one thing the format has, station by station, each with its to-do list as the checklist. The desk plays it through (TESTROOM); the same checklist is what an Unreal build is compared against (docs/UNREAL_NEXT.md).

note_code.title: The vault
note_code.text: Vault code: 4071. Don't write it anywhere else.

diary.title: Lab diary
diary.text: Day 1. Every room tests one thing. If a room works here, it has to work in the real build too. Write down anything that looks different.

note_painting.title: Behind the frame
note_painting.text: If you're reading this, you looked long enough. Most testers never do.

note_annex.title: Annex
note_annex.text: The annex runs on its own fuse. Bring one from the vault.

aoi_knock.en: It's me. Are you going to let me in?

aoi_kettle.en: Could you put the kettle on for me?

aoi_idle.name: testroom_aoi_idle
aoi_idle.prompt: A person stands still breathing slowly

aoi_walk.name: testroom_aoi_walk
aoi_walk.prompt: A person walks slowly while looking around

aoi_count.name: testroom_aoi_count
aoi_count.prompt: A person stands facing a wall covering their eyes with their hands

props.text: Binders, one for every room in the lab. The last one is labelled with your name.
Aoi in a lab coat, squinting at the camera. On the back: "First day. Don't let them see you're scared."

clips.en: You made it. Welcome to the lab.

segments.name: testroom_hello_c1_01_lookup
segments.prompt: A person standing with their head lowered slowly raises their head

clips.en: Every room down that corridor tests one thing.
I'll need a name for the report.
You've done well. Most testers give up at the dark room.
clips.act: turns to face you in the middle of the room

segments.name: testroom_talk_c1_01_turnroom
segments.prompt: A person turns around slowly to face forward

body.prompt: turns to face you in the middle of the room

clips.en: Tell me honestly. Do you trust me?
You've done well. Most testers give up at the dark room.
clips.act: turns to face you from the bench

segments.name: testroom_talk_c1_01_turnbench
segments.prompt: A person turns around slowly to face forward

body.prompt: turns to face you from the bench

clips.en: Tell me honestly. Do you trust me?

clips.act: pulls the locker open and grabs your collar

body.prompt: pulls the locker open and grabs your collar

clips.act: pulls the locker open and grabs your collar

body.prompt: pulls the locker open and grabs your collar

clips.en: You're awake. Good. One last room: the annex.
clips.act: at the door, half in the dark

body.prompt: at the door, half in the dark

clips.en: That's not yours. Put her back.
clips.act: at the far end of the corridor, not moving

body.prompt: at the far end of the corridor, not moving

clips.en: You found my note. Then you know I wrote these tests.

do.objective: 1 · Moving: walk (W A S D), run (Shift), crouch (C); open the front door

do.think: The lab's lights are on. Someone's expecting me.

do.text: Shut the door and lock it (the thumb turn)

do.think: Locked. She'll find another way in.

do.objective: 3 · Doors and keys: the keys room, the closet, the store and its vault

do.think: It slammed. It isn't locked... is it?
The power's gone. The candle's still burning.

do.objective: 5 · In your hands: the inventory (E), carrying, putting down (G)

do.text: Carry the box to the shelf and put it down (G)

do.objective: 6 · Little things: the kettle, a cup, the cigarette, the TV, the hob

do.text: Turn the hob on and let the pot heat
Answer the phone when it rings

do.think: She sat down to wait for her tea.

do.objective: 7 · Chores: mop, scrub, lock the back door

do.text: Mop up the mud (hold the click)

do.objective: 8 · Sitting: a chair, and the sofa (Aoi has something to ask)

do.think: {name}. She'll write that in the report.

do.objective: 9 · Games: the die, chō-han with Aoi
10 · The dark: find the flashlight, F switches it

do.text: Get out of the dark room

do.think: Dead. There were batteries on the shelf.

do.objective: 11 · Reading and looking: the diary, the photo, the shelf, the painting

do.text: Pick up the photo and turn it over
Look at the painting for a while

do.think: Something slipped out from behind the frame.
She left it for whoever looked.

play.rule: Hide before Aoi counts to ten
play.warn: she counts out loud, eyes covered

do.objective: 15 · Run: the atrium, before the lights go
16 · Sneak: cross the atrium without Aoi seeing you
17 · Night: sleep in the rest room's bed
18 · The annex: the fuse, the note; then leave, or stay

do.text: Put the fuse in the fusebox

do.objective: Leave by the door, or sit with Aoi

painting.hint: the painting in the library, looked at long enough

ach_good.title: Passed
ach_good.text: Finish the tests on good terms.

ach_bad.title: Failed
ach_bad.text: Finish the tests on bad terms.

ach_painting.title: Behind the Frame
ach_painting.text: Some paintings are worth a longer look.
